aboutGame.title: What is BloxNote?
paragraphs: BloxNote is an intense social deduction and psychological strategy game on Roblox inspired by the Death Note anime universe. Players are split into opposing factions: the Investigators led by the brilliant detective L, and the mysterious killer Kira accompanied by loyal followers.

Every round is a thrilling battle of wits. Complete tasks, investigate suspicious behavior, or secretly eliminate targets using the power of the notebook. Whether you seek justice or aim to create a new world, strategy and deception are your greatest weapons.

items.question: What is BloxNote on Roblox?
items.answer: BloxNote is a social deduction and detective strategy Roblox game inspired by the Death Note universe. Players take on secret roles as Investigators or Kira, competing to solve mysteries or eliminate targets.

items.question: How do you play as Kira in BloxNote?
items.answer: As Kira, your objective is to secretly eliminate investigators without revealing your identity. Blend in by pretending to complete tasks and build false alibis during group discussions.

items.question: How do Investigators and L win in BloxNote?
items.answer: Investigators win by completing all tasks across the map or by identifying and voting out Kira during emergency meetings.
